presentation: Actual software WebGPU offscreen render and CPU readback
scope: Grade changes only the final transfer; detailAA changes live receiver noise/specular filtering. The cached probe remains the same AA-on bake in every state.

report.reason: CPU readback presentation is diagnostic only; hardware swapchain measurement is required.
report.browser: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
report.readbackOverhead: GPU copy, async map, BGRA→RGBA conversion and 2D upload included in frame times

materials.coordinates: Authored primitive-local metres and half extents

environment.source: Six native HDR renders of actual procedural corridor geometry, direct lights and geometric shadows
environment.prefilter: 128-sample GGX importance convolution per mip texel

hdr.alpha: Per-material/ray-bounded corridor coverage; HDR dust preserves destination alpha
hdr.dither: Stable triangular, quarter code-value amplitude; legacy bypass remains exact
hdr.toneMapping: Lighting + reflection → shadowed scattering → linear HDR bloom → one final exposure/filmic/gamma; exact legacy display bypass elsewhere

fog.source: Same authored light table/shadows, three-step source-path extinction and actual-room probe bounce

bloom.source: Only scoped linear HDR luminance above threshold
